_about: AOS-SFR-2026-001 instrument, version 1.0, frozen 16 September 2026 as the sweep wrote it (analyze.py, CATEGORY_PREFIXES and TITLE_TERMS). A notice is in P2 if its UNSPSC classification id starts with any prefix, or its contracts[].description matches any title regex. Flags: every title regex is case-insensitive except the two marked case-sensitive.

category_prefixes.43: UNSPSC segment 43 Information Technology Broadcasting and Telecommunications (all families)
category_prefixes.8112: UNSPSC family 8112 Data services (incl. data processing)
category_prefixes.8116: UNSPSC family 8116 cloud service families (81162000 SaaS, 81162100 PaaS, 81162103 Platform software as a service, 81162200 IaaS)
category_prefixes.80101507: UNSPSC commodity 80101507 Information technology consultation services
